title: Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1989
ACT XI OF 1989
PUNJAB SUPERVISION
AND CONTROL OF CHILDREN HOMES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th July, 1989]
No. Legis.2(24)/89/61, dated
26-7-1989: -The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes
(Amendment) Bill, 1989, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 6th day of July, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 22nd day of July, 1989, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Supervision and
Control of Children Homes (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Act XVI of 1976

ACT XI OF 1989
ACT XI OF 1989
PUNJAB SUPERVISION
AND CONTROL OF CHILDREN HOMES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th July, 1989]
No. Legis.2(24)/89/61, dated
26-7-1989: -The Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes
(Amendment) Bill, 1989, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 6th day of July, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on the 22nd day of July, 1989, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act XVI of 1976.--In the Punjab Supervision and Control of Children Homes
Act, 1976 (XVI of 1976), in section 2, in clause (f) for the word
"Director" the words "Director-General" shall be
substituted.
